canonical_data: json5 agent configurations and system prompts
current_repo_note: The Go runtime on main ships only as the rolling nightly pre-release; the latest tagged release, v1.0.2-beta.2 of 2026-04-29, is the deprecated Python runtime with no binaries.
strengths: An LLM chooses named actions and connectors carry them out; the README documents a Unitree Go2 movement connector and full autonomy with the BrainPack module on four robots
Inputs, models, and actions are composed in a json5 config file
Ollama is documented as a local substitute for the language model
weaknesses: The default model path runs through OpenMind's hosted endpoint and needs an account key; only the LLM has a documented local substitute
The maintained runtime has no tagged release; the README's release link points at a deprecated beta
The docs describe a robot-identity network and a blockchain governance system it says it is exploring, neither of which the README mentions
Low-level control and collision avoidance are delegated to the robot's own SDK
why_it_matters: An LLM agent loop whose actions are a robot's motion rather than a file or a browser.
